newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi Hotels Co declares 10-one share split.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi Hotels Co declares 10-one share split.

text.p: The Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co on Sunday declared a 10-for-one share split in a bid to widen the shareholder base and increase trade turnover, the company's chairman said.
The new nominal share value is 10 dirhams from 100 dirhams each, he said.

"The purpose of this step is to expand the shareholder base and to increase trade turnover," said chairman Khalifa Nasser al-Mansouri. "The value of the share is currently too high and hence trade turnover is very low."
The stock ended last week at 1,070 dirhams, up from 1,065 a week earlier and 980 dirhams a year ago.

Shareholders at the company's annual general meeting on Sunday asked the firm to increase the number of shares an investor may hold to 40,000 shares from a current 4,000 in line with the share split. -- Dubai newsroom +971 4 6071 222
